WELCOME TO GREENBROOK VILLAGE IN LAKEWOOD RANCH
Pride of ownership shines throughout this impeccably maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home with a 2-car garage, offering 1,275 square feet of comfortable living space on a quiet cul-de-sac street.
The open-concept floor plan creates a bright and inviting atmosphere, with sightlines extending from the front entry through the great room to the screened lanai and picturesque lake beyond. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a large designer-style sink, breakfast bar seating for four, and a cozy eat-in dining area.
The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat with an en-suite bath featuring a garden tub, separate shower, and large walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies.
Step outside to the covered and screened lanai where you'll enjoy peaceful lake views, breathtaking Florida sunsets, and a private backyard with plenty of room for a future pool.
Recent Updates Include:
• New Roof (2023)
• Exterior Painted (2025)
• New Laminate Flooring Throughout Main Living Areas
• New Carpet in Bedrooms
• New Lighting Fixtures
• New Blinds Throughout the Home
• Generator Hookup/Electrical Connection Installed
• Whole-House and AC Surge Protection
Greenbrook Village offers an exceptional lifestyle with parks, playgrounds, sports fields, scenic walking and biking trails, and one of the area's most popular dog parks. Families will appreciate the highly rated schools, including an elementary school conveniently located just around the corner.
Enjoy easy access to Lakewood Ranch Main Street featuring shopping, dining, and a movie theater, while I-75 is only minutes away for convenient commuting. This move-in-ready home is available now—just in time to settle in before the new school year begins.

samples.propertyDescription: Welcome to one of Lakewood Ranch's most sought-after addresses — Greenbrook Village (Vistas). This beautifully updated and meticulously maintained home strikes the perfect balance of comfort, style, and everyday functionality. With 5 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, a half bath, and a flexible office/den, this home is ready to fit your life from day one. From the moment you step inside, a bright, open foyer sets the tone. To your left, you'll find a cozy office/den — ideal for working from home or a quiet reading nook. Moving into the heart of the home, the open-concept living area is anchored by a stunning gourmet kitchen that truly steals the show. It features premium 42" upper cabinetry, on-trend quartz countertops, a large center island, a spacious walk-in pantry, abundant prep space, and a gas stove — everything you need to cook, host, and gather with ease. The first floor is laid out in a smart split-bedroom plan. The luxurious primary suite is a genuine retreat, bathed in natural light with elegant finishes and a spa-inspired en-suite bath complete with a walk-in shower, a relaxing garden tub, dual vanities, and a generous dual walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed full bath with a step-in shower — perfect for family or guests. A fourth bedroom enjoys its own private full bath with a walk-in shower that also conveniently connects to the pool area. Whether it's a formal dinner in the dining room or a casual bite in the charming breakfast nook, you'll have flexible dining options for every occasion. Step through the oversized sliding glass doors and you'll find your own private paradise — an extended screened-in lanai with a heated pool and spa. It's the perfect spot for morning coffee, weekend entertaining, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. Head upstairs to discover the 5th bedroom with a half bath — a great flex space for guests, a playroom, or a teen suite. Throughout the home, soaring ceilings and abundant natural light give every room an airy, welcoming feel. An indoor laundry room adds everyday convenience, and the 3-car garage offers ample space for vehicles, storage, or a workshop. This home comes with a 2021 HVAC system, a newer swimming pool pump and heat pump, a whole-home water softener, renovated bathrooms, a refreshed kitchen with newer appliances and quartz countertops, new luxury vinyl flooring in all bedrooms, and fresh interior paint in 2026. Move right in and enjoy. The value here is hard to beat: an ultra-low annual HOA fee of just $121, a low CDD fee, and — notably — no flood insurance required. That's a rare combination in Lakewood Ranch. Location-wise, it doesn't get much better. Zoned for top-rated schools and just minutes from Greenbrook Adventure Park (think nature trails, playgrounds, sports courts, a dog park, and picnic areas), this home also puts you close to I-75, UTC Mall, Costco, premier golf courses, Sarasota Memorial Hospital, the Premier Sports Campus, area, airports, and the world-renowned Gulf beaches, including Siesta Key. This is Florida living at its finest — peaceful, connected, and completely move-in ready. Se habla español.

Welcome to this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath pool home located in one of Lakewood Ranch's most desirable neighborhoods Greenbrook Banks! First time on the market for this one of a kind home. A Perfect Family home close to top rated schools only a short bike ride away in the neighborhood.   Offering an exceptional blend of comfort, functionality, and modern upgrades, this spacious residence features soaring 10-foot ceilings on both the first and second floors, creating an open and airy atmosphere throughout.  Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home includes a dedicated first-floor office, generous living spaces, and a private backyard retreat complete with a sparkling pool, travertine pool pavers, and a recently added dog run. The home is equipped with natural gas, including a gas stove, gas dryer, gas tankless water heater, and gas pool heater—an increasingly sought-after feature for efficiency and convenience.  The kitchen has been thoughtfully refreshed with a new sink and touchless faucet installed in 2026, while custom storage solutions throughout the home maximize organization and functionality. California Closets systems have been installed in the pantry, first-floor coat closet, primary bedroom closets, and two secondary bedrooms. Additional custom storage closets were added upstairs in 2025, providing abundant space for modern living.  Recent major improvements provide peace of mind for years to come, including a new roof and additional gutters (2024), two new air conditioning systems (December 2024), a new electrical circuit breaker panel (2026), updated flooring in three bedrooms (2025), new ceiling fans throughout the home, and upgraded exterior lighting including garage fixtures and a decorative light post. The home's exterior was professionally painted in 2020, and the interior was refreshed in 2022.  This meticulously maintained property offers the perfect combination of luxury, practicality, and value with significant recent investments already completed for the next owner.  Located within the award-winning Lakewood Ranch master-planned community, residents enjoy access to a vibrant lifestyle featuring miles of walking and biking trails, parks, nature preserves, community events, top-rated schools, shopping, dining, entertainment, golf, sports facilities, and the popular Waterside Place and Lakewood Ranch Main Street districts. Lakewood Ranch is known for its extensive trail network, abundant parks and open spaces, and dynamic year-round community events that make it one of the most sought-after destinations on Florida's Gulf Coast.  Conveniently located near Sarasota's world-famous beaches, UTC shopping and dining, premier medical facilities, and major transportation corridors, this exceptional pool home offers the very best of Florida living.

samples.propertyDescription:
Welcome home to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath retreat nestled in the heart of Greenbrook Village, one of Lakewood Ranch's most beloved communities. With 1,738 square feet of bright, flowing living space, this home was thoughtfully designed for easy, comfortable living from the moment you walk in.
The updated modern kitchen is the heart of the home. Stylish, functional, and ready for everything from quiet morning coffee to lively family gatherings. A flexible office space with double pocket doors offers the perfect work-from-home/gym setup or an easy conversion to a fourth bedroom. Then step outside and discover your own private sanctuary. A sparkling heated pool and oversized hot tub anchor the screened lanai, perfect for soaking under the Florida sun or unwinding on a warm evening year-round. Beyond the water, a lush preserve view, a butterfly garden attracting nature's most colorful visitors, and small fruit trees promising a sweet harvest make this outdoor space truly one of a kind.
Thoughtfully designed with handicap accessibility, this home welcomes everyone at every stage of life. Furnishings are negotiable, making your transition that much easier.
Greenbrook Village has many parks, 150 miles of walking and biking trails, an adventure park with playgrounds and sports fields, and one of the best dog parks around, all just steps away. Zoned for McNeal Elementary, Nolan Middle, and Lakewood Ranch High School. LWR Main Street puts shops, restaurants, a farmers market, miniature golf, and a movie theater within easy reach, and the nation's best beaches are less than 45 minutes away. With quick access to I-75, everything the area has to offer is right at your fingertips.
Move-in ready for whatever chapter comes next.

samples.propertyDescription: Located in Greenbrook Run of Lakewood Ranch, home has low HOA and CDD in Flood Zone X. This is a must see, owner has spared no expense with all the upgrades added to this home! Home offers 4 bedrooms, master on first floor, 3 ½ bathrooms, den, bonus room, living, dining and family rooms. Eat in kitchen offers bay window with bench seating at table area, Samsung stainless steel appliances, granite counter tops, tile back splash, white wood cabinets and plank tile flooring. House has been updated with 5” wood baseboards, flooring (tile, wood and luxury vinyl – no carpet) and Sherwin Williams paint throughout. All Bathrooms have NEW quartz counter tops, toilets, tile floors, vessel sinks, faucets, fixtures, lights, mirrors, medicine cabinets, shower tile and new upstairs tubs. All bedroom’s closets have wood built-in shelving, tray ceilings (also in bonus room) with recessed lighting. White wood Ship lap in some areas and wood chair rail with picture framing in dining/living rooms add charming character to the home. Added Bonus…Roof replaced in 2022, 50-gallon gas water heater in 2020 and exterior of home painted in 2022. Laundry room has recessed lighting, large Samsung front load stackable washer/dryer and built-in bench with shelves and coat hooks. Back yard is perfect for anyone looking to build a pool or fence in for additional privacy and has natural gas line for grill. Home is close to Greenbrook Adventure Park that connects to numerous walking/bike trails, and also has a dog park, playground, in-line skating rink, sand volleyball court, work out area, basketball court and large green space used for soccer, baseball and other events throughout the year. Also included at Adventure Park is a new Pavilion with picnic tables, benches, bathrooms and grill area perfect for events. Schools within the “Ranch” consists of both public and private with excellent ratings. Lakewood Ranch is conveniently located close I-75 and many attractions in Florida and the surrounding area such as UTC Mall, many golf courses, Premier Sports Center, beaches including the white sand at Siesta Key and much more the Sunshine State has to offer!
